findings.title: days_late does not reconcile
findings.detail: The supplied days_late disagrees with a date-based recomputation on 56.5% of rows (mean difference 1.6 days). Both columns are retained; the recomputed value is used.

findings.title: po_id year prefix is not the order year
findings.detail: The four-digit prefix in po_id disagrees with po_date on 67.9% of rows. All time grouping uses po_date; po_id is treated as an opaque label.

findings.title: Fact table built
findings.detail: 4,800 purchase orders, 34 suppliers, 18 categories, 2021-2024.

findings.title: Price benchmark coverage
findings.detail: peer_period: 99.9%; peer_all_time: 0.1%. Benchmark = median price quoted by other suppliers for the same material in the same quarter.

findings.title: Market index not comparable
findings.detail: SS Pipes: index Rs 192,401/MT vs panel median Rs 79,637/MT (0.41x). Not quoted in briefs.

findings.title: Market index used as context only
findings.detail: The index covers 6 of 18 materials and, where it exists, the whole panel pays a median 1.19x the index -- a market-wide gap, not a supplier-specific one. Price premium is measured against peer suppliers instead.

findings.title: Candidates built
findings.detail: 12,911 (return, supplier) pairs across 380 returns -- 34.0 candidate suppliers per return. All features use only deliveries dated on or before the return.

findings.title: Attribution model trained
findings.detail: Logistic regression on 8,154 pairs from 240 labelled returns, 5-fold CV grouped by return; blend weight on the model 1.00. Top-1 20.8%, top-3 55.8%; 5.3% of return value misallocated in aggregate vs 47.0% for the best baseline and 47.9% for the problem statement's most-recent-batch rule.

findings.title: Per-order losses computed
findings.detail: short-delivery Rs 78,670,629; rejected material Rs 22,997,595 across 4,800 orders.

findings.title: Price premium tested
findings.detail: 0 of 34 suppliers charge a premium over peers that survives a 5% false-discovery-rate correction. Per-order prices vary widely around the peer median, so no supplier-level price claim is made in rupees; premiums are still reported with confidence intervals.

findings.title: Return value allocated
findings.detail: Rs 81,217,272 across 380 of 380 returns (recorded Rs 49,821,782; inferred Rs 31,395,490).

findings.title: Scorecard built
findings.detail: 34 suppliers scored on 4 dimensions (weights {'short_delivery': 0.3, 'quality_rejection': 0.25, 'price_premium': 0.2, 'late_delivery': 0.25}); shrinkage k=5 orders. years_of_relationship not used.

findings.title: Blind validation
findings.detail: The dataset's own `is_underperformer` flag marks ['VS03', 'VS12', 'VS19']. Our bottom 3, computed without it: ['VS03', 'VS19', 'VS12']. 3/3 match.
